title: Smaller Than Most, And Drawers Fall Easily
text:
Smaller Than Most, And Drawers Fall Easily. This is smaller than most sets like this, so if you're assuming it will fit next to you existing one, check the dimensions.

The drawers have to be balanced pretty well, otherwise they fall easily.

But overall it does hold toys and looks fine so 3 stars.
